list.content: Drawings Drawings are every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday night at 10 p.m. Lotto America is $1 per play. The Lotto America jackpot begins at $2 million and grows until someone wins! Purchase your Lotto America ticket at any participating retailer. Tickets may be purchased until 9 p.m. central on the evening of the draw.
All Star Bonus For $1 more, you can get the optional All Star Bonus! The All Star Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your non-jackpot prize by 2, 3, 4, or 5.
NUMBERS Select five numbers from 1 to 52 for white balls; then select one number from 1 to 10 for the All Star Ball.
WINNING Players win a prize by matching one of the nine ways to win. Head to the Players Club to Check Your Numbers and find out if you're a winner.
LEARN MORE Visit the Lotto America website to learn more.

layouts.content:
Prizes of $100 or Less

Sign the back of your ticket and present it to your local lottery retailer.

Prizes of $101 or More

These must be paid by the Lottery. You can claim your prize by mail:
  • Sign the back of the ticket in the space provided.
  • Fill out a claim form, available at your local lottery retailer. Or use the online Claim Form. Simply type in your information, print it off, sign and date it.
  • Send the completed claim form and winning ticket to the Lottery at 711 E Wells Ave., Pierre, SD 57501.
  • You should receive your prize money in 7-10 days.

• You may also claim your prize in person by visiting one of our validation centers in Pierre, Rapid City or Sioux Falls.
  • Any jackpot-winning ticket or the second prizes for Lotto America must be presented in person at a Lottery office. A jackpot-winning Lotto America ticket must be presented in person at the Lottery office in Pierre at 711 E Wells Ave., Pierre, SD 57501.

Jackpot Winner?

Congratulations! Our first advice is that you immediately sign the back of the ticket and put it in a safe place. We strongly encourage you to take your time and seek professional financial and legal advice. We also offer a Winner’s Handbook with some tips to help you. When you’re ready, give us a call to make arrangements to validate the ticket and claim your prize.
